text.tspan: PASSIVE BASELINE / COMPLETE RECORD BEFORE CLAIMING A MEASURED RESULT
Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
Retain a simultaneous input or reference.
Complete reviewed mechanical and stability criteria first.
Damp strings; fixed mounts and repeatable excitation.
Pitch, harmonics, drift and defined 10 dB decay interval.
H = Y/F only with measured input; otherwise response ratio.
Tufts clear of strings; optional guarded external fan >=12 in away.
External speaker >=3 ft away; 20-200 Hz; predeclared SPL ceiling.
After T0-T7 pass; separate reassessment and S1 electrical limits.
Single isolated mode with exponential amplitude decay only. Record fit band, interval, noise floor and
uncertainty. Unresolved beating, clipping, gain changes or multiple modes prevent a single-mode Q
Keep raw recordings and configuration ID, date/time, string identities, pitches/tensions, sample rate, gain,
sensors, excitation, room state, temperature, anomalies and stop reason. Start with at least three repeats;
Phase 2 source limit: isolated fused 12-24 VDC, <=30 W, no mains inside assembly; mount temperature rise <=10
C after 10 min. No powered exciter is part of this baseline.
